authorized: 2026-10-22 human asks actual independent new-rule maintenance comparison and detailed LLM cases
scope: Offline authored policy-document release rule, added alongside existing receipt/BOM implementations. No paid calls, no legal/operational truth or human labor claims.
new_question: May this exact policy document revision be released on the assessment date?
input: document{id,revision,author,status}; review{document_id,revision,reviewer,decision}; qualification{person,role,start,end}; assessment_date. Each row has occurrence_id. Lookup uses exact document/revision; qualification uses reviewer and required role.
decisions: One document matching question and one linked review and one reviewer/required-role qualification required. Absent or multiple matches yield unknown for that link, not global absence. Missing unrecognized scalar or invalid date yields unknown; explicit supported failed conditions blocked; known failure overrides unknown; otherwise eligible. Review status supports Accept/Reject, document Draft/Approved. Evidence is the exact matching/ambiguous row occurrence IDs; quote source authored-policy-v1. Do not inspect evaluation reference at runtime.
arms: Modular Python extension: indexed joins, explicit predicates and JSON policy
RDF extension: row-to-RDF mapping, SHACL Core joins/cardinality/status/difference/date constraints and report adapter. No OWL needed for this new task
fairness: Common scalar parsing and exact joins may be shared only if no verdicts/comparisons are precomputed; disclose all shared responsibilities
Original technology_selection modules/configs and 198 historical outputs remain unchanged. Compose old arms with new independent extension; no monolithic Python strawman
Same per-condition diagnostics and source row witnesses, same supported/unknown semantics, no presumed ontology superiority

matrix.note: 16*3*2*2*2 arms=384; repetitions/renaming are not independent business trials

regression: Run original22 frozen cases once per old Python/RDF arm before and after extension in same process, 88 baseline output comparisons in total (22*2arms*2moments); compare to saved baseline and independent refs. No old campaign or paid rerun. Any regression preserved. Do not mix new384 with old88 accuracy.
sharing: Three explicit consumers use one approved policy artifact per arm; v2 changes required role only. Record artifact hashes and all three consumer outputs. Local pinned configuration reuse, not distributed collaboration experiment.
human_review: Generate static read-only HTML containing policy source quote, changed files/semantic sites, input/output/witnesses, v1/v2 artifact hashes. Human approval and GUI usability are not experimentally measured; no automatic approval simulation.
measure: Before/after source bytes, new/edited files, semantic responsibility locations (ingestion/joins/policy/engine/report/integration), dependency map, first frozen execution outcomes, regressions, shared-version agreement, unsupported/missing evidence. File/LOC footprint not human effort or universal maintainability.
scorer: Separately authored explicit scenario expectations frozen before first execution; no runtime reference access. First mismatch/failure retained; no fixing from evaluation gold. Any implementation revision fresh reviewed run with original outcome retained.
steps: freeze policy, cases and source baseline; independent methods review before execution
implement two modules/shapes/common parsing, composition and independent scorer; native methods+implementation review before any checks or experiment
run bounded experiment once, preserve all first outcomes
write detailed three trace cases and actual extension findings in integrated paper, Korean skill, fresh document review and builds
clarifications: Document selector exact id/revision; review exact document_id/revision; qualification exact reviewer/required_role. Repeated equal rows with distinct occurrence IDs remain ambiguous.
Each supported condition evaluated once its own dependencies resolve; Draft+missing review is blocked with a separate unknown review-link. No global all-links gate.
Malformed date case uses qualification.end=not-a-date; ISO endpoint scalar parsing is shared, interval comparison engine owned.
The 16 scenarios do not exercise absent/duplicate document; contract specifies unknown but branch coverage unclaimed.
RDF materializes joined operand/check nodes; common exact joins and scalar recognition are shared, not inferred by OWL. No raw-document understanding.
88 regression outputs,44 before/after pairs; historical/scorer assertions separately reported.
Both arms read one common JSON policy version. Shared JSON reuse is not RDF-exclusive. SHACL supplies predicate definitions/report vocabulary, not the whole review workflow.
